description.text: The other expansion that opened the Sword & Shield series on 6 December 2019, released together with Sword. The legendary Zamazenta V leads it: its Ability blocks all damage from the attacks of Pokémon VMAX. Morpeko VMAX and Snorlax VMAX are among the first Pokémon VMAX, with Indeedee V, Torkoal V and Sableye V and the Supporters Marnie and Team Yell Grunt. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 60, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Zamazenta V, Quick Ball and Metal Saucer. In English many of its cards came out in Sword & Shield in February 2020.
